Name: Levi
Summary: Levi was the third son of Jacob by Leah, and the father of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. His descendants became Israel's priestly tribe.
KeyStory: Levi joined Simeon in avenging Dinah, yet God later set his tribe apart for the tabernacle and the priesthood — grace redirecting a violent past.
RelatedPeople: Jacob; Leah; Simeon, Son of Jacob; Gershon; Kohath; Merari
LifeLesson: God can take a troubled past and set it apart for holy service.
